तुंगकारण्य

TUṄGAKĀRAṆYA . A holy place. The sage sārasvata did Devatādhyayana on behalf of other sages at this place. (Śloka 46, Chapter 85, Vana Parva).

तुंगवेणा

TUṄGAVEṆĀ . An ancient holy river of bhārata. People of Bhāratae came pure by drinking the water of this river. (Śloka 27, Chapter 6, bhīṣma parva).
